title: My Day: Simple Routines
context: A simple way to talk about your life is to say what you usually do. Use 'I usually…' with a verb and a time, and you can describe a whole day.
contextPersian: یکی از ساده‌ترین راه‌ها برای حرف زدن دربارهٔ زندگی‌ات این است که بگویی معمولاً چه می‌کنی. از «I usually…» با یک فعل و یک زمان استفاده کن تا یک روز کامل را توصیف کنی.

expressions.example: I usually get up at seven.
expressions.note: usually = most days, not every single day.

expressions.example: I have breakfast at half past seven.
expressions.examplePersian: ساعت هفت و نیم صبحانه می‌خورم.
expressions.note: Have breakfast / lunch / dinner — not eat breakfast (both exist, but have is more natural).

expressions.english: I go to work by bus.
expressions.persian: با اتوبوس به سر کار می‌روم.
expressions.example: I go to work by bus, and it takes thirty minutes.
expressions.examplePersian: با اتوبوس به سر کار می‌روم و سی دقیقه طول می‌کشد.
expressions.note: by + vehicle: by bus, by car, by train. But: on foot.

expressions.examplePersian: ساعت نه کارم را شروع می‌کنم.

expressions.example: I usually cook dinner for my family.
expressions.examplePersian: معمولاً برای خانواده‌ام شام درست می‌کنم.

expressions.english: I watch TV in the evening.
expressions.example: I watch TV in the evening, but I never watch the news.
expressions.examplePersian: عصرها تلویزیون تماشا می‌کنم، ولی هیچ‌وقت اخبار نگاه نمی‌کنم.

expressions.example: I go to bed at eleven.
On weekends, I visit my family.
expressions.examplePersian: آخر هفته‌ها به خانواده‌ام سر می‌زنم.

expressions.english: What time do you get up?
expressions.example: What time do you get up? — At six thirty.
expressions.examplePersian: چه ساعتی بیدار می‌شوی؟ — شش و نیم.

expressions.example: I never drink coffee in the evening.
expressions.note: Never already means "not": do not add another not.

options: I usually get up at seven.
I usually getting up at seven.
I am usually get up at seven.
I usually gets up at seven.

targets: I go to work by bus.
exercises.prompt: How do you say you travel to work in a bus?
options: I go to work by bus.
I go to work with bus.
I go to work in the bus.

exercises.hint: The first meal of the day.
exercises.explanationPersian: با وعده‌های غذایی از have استفاده می‌کنیم: have breakfast / lunch / dinner.
go to bed یعنی به رختخواب رفتن.

acceptedAnswers: I usually get up at seven.
I usually wake up at seven.
I normally get up at seven.

commonErrors.feedbackPersian: جمله را با I usually شروع کن.

commonErrors.feedback: No 'the' before a clock time: at seven.
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: قبل از ساعت the نمی‌آید: at seven.

exercises.explanation: usually goes before the main verb.
exercises.explanationPersian: usually قبل از فعل اصلی می‌آید.

acceptedAnswers: I finish work at five o'clock.
I get off work at five.
I never drink coffee in the evening.
I never drink coffee in the evenings.
In the evening I never drink coffee.

commonErrors.feedback: 'never' is already negative: I never drink.
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: never خودش منفی است: I never drink.

exercises.explanationPersian: never خودش منفی است. don't اضافه نکن.

exercises.prompt: "I get up at six, I have breakfast at seven and I start work at eight." What time does this person start work?
exercises.explanationPersian: ساعت هشت کار را شروع می‌کند.

exercises.incorrectSentence: I am usually go to bed at eleven.
acceptedAnswers: I usually go to bed at eleven.
exercises.explanation: No 'am' before a normal verb: I usually go.
exercises.explanationPersian: قبل از فعل معمولی am نمی‌آید: I usually go.

exercises.audioText: I usually get up at seven.
acceptedAnswers: I usually get up at seven.

speakingTask.instruction: Describe your morning: when you get up, have breakfast and go to work.
speakingTask.instructionPersian: صبح خودت را توصیف کن: کِی بیدار می‌شوی، صبحانه می‌خوری و به سر کار می‌روی.
modelSentences: I usually get up at seven.
I have breakfast at half past seven.
I go to work by bus.
I start work at nine and I finish at five.

roleplay.aiRole: A friendly colleague at a new job
roleplay.objective: Talk about your usual day and ask about theirs
roleplay.context: It is your first week at a new job. A colleague is curious about your day: when you get up, how you travel, when you finish. Answer with simple sentences and ask them the same.
roleplay.opening: Hi! How do you get to work? And what time do you usually get up?
